claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SB-200646 is a serotonin 5-HT2B/2C antagonist that is unlikely to kill cells at 2.5 uM; any weak, non-selective killing would most plausibly reflect a cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress effect rather than its annotated receptor antagonism.
